ai_summary: The Board of Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited has approved the amalgamation with Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited, becoming effective on November 1, 2026, after receiving all necessary regulatory sanctions. This merger will increase Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited's authorized share capital to INR 1,100,000,000, and existing shareholders of Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited will receive 23 shares of the merged entity for every 2 shares held. The document indicates a straightforward completion of a planned corporate action, with no apparent red flags.
